description: Create Phase 400 (generate-plans) skill that converts the existing framework/400-Mod-Plan/README.md prompts into a self-contained, invocable Kiro skill. The skill covers all three plan types (PoC, EBA, full project) in a single invocation, explains the sequencing (PoC validates unknowns for EBAs, EBAs establish patterns for full projects), references templates and sample outputs, and includes the EBA Preparation Checklist as a post-generation step. Also update the engagement template and README.md with skills references.
steps: Create .kiro/skills/generate-plans/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter (name: generate-plans, description about Phase 400 execution plan generation covering PoC, EBA, and full project plans). The workflow should cover: Step 1 - Identify customer and validate Phase 300 readiness, Step 2 - Classify applications by execution path, Step 3 - Generate PoC plans for EXPLORING decisions, Step 4 - Generate EBA plans for eligible applications, Step 5 - Generate full modernization plans for large/complex applications, Step 6 - Cross-reference and dependency validation, Step 7 - Post-generation: EBA Preparation Checklist, Step 8 - Mark Phase 400 complete.
Include the plan sequencing logic: PoCs come before EBAs (validate unknowns), EBAs come before full projects (establish patterns).

Reference all framework files: framework/400-Mod-Plan/420-PoC/PoC-Plan-Template.md, framework/400-Mod-Plan/430-EBA/EBA-Plan-Template.md, framework/400-Mod-Plan/430-EBA/EBA-Preparation-Checklist.md, and both sample outputs.
Reference the detailed-assessment skill as the upstream dependency.
Update framework/engagement-template.md to add a note about skills as the primary invocation method.
Update README.md at the workspace root to add a section listing all available skills.
